study_type: Synthetic full-factorial extension of the frozen assumption stress study
research_question: How do endurance, launch latency and reserve stresses interact within the existing dispatch model?
estimand: For each nonempty factor subset, average its signed finite difference over all levels of the remaining factors; event-weight real alerts, including rejected missions
units: percentage points; two-factor terms are full differences-in-differences, not half-scaled orthogonal factorial effects
uncertainty: 1000 paired whole-season percentile bootstrap draws; 95% pointwise Monte Carlo intervals only, not simultaneous or input/model uncertainty
non_goals: No regeneration of alerts or rerunning the 20 source scenarios
No new flight model, dispatch policy, observed weather or measured aircraft assumptions
No independent replication, global sensitivity analysis, optimization or field validation
No detector accuracy, autonomous flight or operational authorization claim
